finding.title: Route HebrewDatePicker's 5 hardcoded English strings through AppLocalizations
finding.why: HebrewDatePicker is opened from GoalSetupForm._pickHebrewDate() whenever useHebrewDateProvider is true — exactly the users who most want a Hebrew-first UI see 'Select Hebrew date', 'Hebrew year', 'Month', 'Day' and 'English: ...' in raw English, while the Cancel button and confirm button in the SAME dialog correctly use AppLocalizations. This isn't a deliberate all-English widget: it's an inconsistent half-migration. Worse, test/features/scheduler/widgets/hebrew_date_picker_test.dart:33 and :46 assert `find.text('Select Hebrew date')` and `find.textContaining('English:')`, locking the English strings in as 'correct' — any future fix that localizes these strings will fail that test until it is also updated, so the bug is actively defended by its own test suite.
finding.recommendation: Add ARB keys (EN+HE) for the 5 strings and swap them in; update hebrew_date_picker_test.dart to assert against the localized value (or a semantics/key lookup) instead of the literal English text.
acceptance_criteria: No literal English string literals remain in hebrew_date_picker.dart's build tree (dialog title, year label, Month/Day field labels, English-date prefix).
`make arb-parity` still reports full EN/HE key parity with the new keys added.
hebrew_date_picker_test.dart asserts on localized text (or l10n keys), not hardcoded English literals.
